name: Quadratic Regression for Distance Fields
definition: A method to approximate the zero level surface of a noisy 3D distance field F by fitting a quadratic function f(x,y,z) to neighboring grid points within an Axis Aligned Bounding Box (AABB). It solves for filtering (extracting the constant term p_000) and normal vector estimation (extracting the gradient coefficients).
summary: Quadratic Regression for Distance Fields approximates noisy 3D distance fields using quadratic functions to capture curvature, enabling smoother gradient estimation than linear variants.
